meta.checkout_hint: When the user picks an offer — in any wording («беру», «самый быстрый», «оформи», «забронируй») — the normal hand-over is `create_checkout_link` with that offer's `checkout_ref`; put the returned link in your reply. This payload deliberately carries no ready checkout link: the link comes from that tool, never from URL parts you assemble yourself.

pricing.note: Prices on this page already cover the WHOLE searched party — never multiply them by the passenger count.
